q1.explanationZh: 第三段说，一些家长喜欢这项活动，因为它能让孩子更有耐心、更有创造力。A和C文中都没有说。

evidence.quote: Some parents also enjoy the activity because it helps children become more patient and creative.

q2.explanationZh: 第四段说，很多学生喜欢把小小的拼豆拼成彩色的艺术作品。

evidence.quote: Many students say they enjoy turning small beads into colorful art.

q3.explanationZh: 最后一段，专家提醒大家要选安全、质量好的产品，还要有大人陪着用。
q3.tipsZh: remind sb. to do sth. 意思是“提醒某人做某事”。

evidence.quote: Experts remind families to choose safe and high-quality products.
